title: Best old bands: Sam Morgan for dancing
summary: He never heard young Armstrong or Oliver in New Orleans; Sam Morgan's band had the best beat for dancing.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever hear Louis Armstrong when he was young down here before he went north?

Or Joe Oliver? Anita. What would be the best of the old time bands that you ever heard that you can remember? If you had to pick one band either that you played with or that you didn't play with that you used to hear at dances. What would be the best band that you can think of that you've heard?
Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.
Did they have a better beat than the other bands or what made them good? The tempo or what was it that made them good?
Well, I just had a better beat.

How was Sam Morgan individually as a trumpet player? Was he one of the outstanding ones? That is, was he powerful and a wonderful tone or how was he compared to say Buddy Petit and Chris and the other fellows?
He was pretty strong and he had a real nice tone.
Did you ever play with Sam Morgan band? You mentioned Isaiah.
No, I never played with Sam.
